author: Rebiz
name: ActivityRoles
install_msg: Use /config to assign roles for Crunchyroll, YouTube, and Spotify presence detection.
short: Auto-assigns roles when members are watching Crunchyroll, YouTube, or listening to Spotify.
description: Monitors Discord Rich Presence activity and assigns configurable roles while a member is actively watching Crunchyroll or YouTube, or listening to Spotify. Roles are removed when the activity ends.
